target: Codex governed `/deliver-full` entry path — architect-stage ownership and subagent routing
summary: The Codex `deliver-full` flow still allows the main session to act as the architect after pipeline entry, so governed staged delegation can drift into inline design work before any BL-011 subagent spawn occurs.
evidence: In the T-009 session on 2026-04-19, after the human approved scope and invoked `$azoth-deliver-full`, the run correctly wrote and validated `.azoth/pipeline-gate.json` and opened a paused `deliver-full` run in `.azoth/run-ledger.local.yaml`. However the main session then investigated T-009 and drafted the Stage 2 architecture brief inline instead of spawning the architect as a fresh-context BL-011 subagent. This happened even though `docs/platform-guides/orchestrator-default-entry.md` states that the Architect is a spawned design/review subagent invoked by the Orchestrator, and `.claude/agents/orchestrator.md` says governed pipeline entry must not be satisfied inline. The immediate symptom looked like another 'approval not consumed' problem, but the deeper cause is a contract split: `.claude/commands/deliver-full.md` only makes stages 3–6 mechanically explicit in the subagent table, while the orchestrator/platform docs treat architect-design as spawned too. Because the Codex wrapper skill routes into a skill-routed, hook-soft path with no single fail-closed transition that says 'entering governed deliver-full requires architect spawn now,' the main session can still satisfy the command conversationally by becoming the architect itself.
recommended_action: Unify governed stage ownership across the deliver-full contract and orchestrator runtime. Pick one explicit rule for Stage 2 in Codex and make it mechanical: either (a) architect-design is always a BL-011 spawned subagent on governed `deliver-full`, or (b) Stage 2 is intentionally orchestrator-inline and the orchestrator/platform docs must stop claiming architect is always spawned for that stage. Then add regression coverage for the Codex skill-routed path: after `$azoth-deliver-full` opens Stage 0 successfully, the next execution step must either spawn the architect or fail closed before any inline architecture brief is produced.
